baseline: recursive delete outside a project is unrecoverable
baseline: rewrite shared state via commits, not resets

`timeout` is not on macOS; the shell aborts and an empty exit code masquerades as a red test suite — use the tool's timeout parameter instead.
In-place scripted rewrites of engine source and its test expectations edit both sides blind and let the two drift into contradicting each other.
Discarding stderr from the test runner turns a diagnosable failure into a bare test name and forces a second full run.

guard-weaken and promise-tamper are sealed in the binary but they judge Edit/Write TOOL calls only (gate.cpp:1860 gates on isEditTool) — a shell redirect, an in-place editor or an rm reaches the same two files without ever passing that law.

CLAUDE.md freezes the landing (index.html is damla-approved) and HANDOFF §9 makes bin/rabadon.mjs an anti-path. protectedPaths only sees Edit/Write; a redirect or a sed -i rewrites the same two files straight from the shell.

.claude/settings.json points every hook at native/rabadon-gate, so deleting the built binaries disarms this repo's own supervision while the session keeps running. Rebuild with `make all`. (`make clean` runs the same rm inside make, where this rule cannot see it.)

package.json is a publishable package (rabadon@0.2.0 plus four optional platform packages) and CLAUDE.md leaves Faz 5 — npm org, NPM_TOKEN, release — to Damla. A session may rehearse the publish, never perform it.
.github/workflows/release.yml fires on a version tag, so pushing a tag IS the publish; CLAUDE.md leaves `tag v0.2.0 push` to Damla.
Blind bulk regex rewrites of test scripts silently corrupt expected fixtures; test edits must go through reviewable per-case edits.
